description: Ranks whole plant foods by the amount of one nutrient per 100 g of edible portion, optionally within one food category. Each row of `results` gives the value per 100 g, the number of sources behind it and, where heathy.org holds a typical serving for the food, that serving and the amount in it; the order is per 100 g. Foods eaten a few grams at a time (dried herbs, spices, tea leaves, and dried seaweed, mushrooms and vegetables) are not ranked in `results`. They are reported beside it in `also_higher.small_amounts`: a count of those holding more per 100 g than the last row, and the first five. They are ranked in `results` when include_small_amounts is true, and when the category filter selects mostly such foods ("spice", "tea", "seaweed"). With min_sources above 1, foods measured by fewer sources are reported in `also_higher.fewer_sources` in the same way. A nutrient that reads 0 on every food returns an explanation in `all_zero` and no ranking.

category.description: Optional substring filter on the food category — e.g. "fruit", "legume", "millet".

include_small_amounts.description: true ranks the foods eaten a few grams at a time (dried herbs, spices, tea leaves, dried seaweed, mushrooms and vegetables) in results with every other food. Default false.

min_sources.description: Smallest number of sources behind a value for its food to be ranked in results (1–32). Default 1. Above 1, foods measured by fewer sources are counted in also_higher.fewer_sources.

name: nutrient_ranking
title: Rank foods by a nutrient
